Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the right lane of a multi-lane roadway in Baytown, Texas, when Driver 1 moved left to change
lanes and made contact with the side of a veihcle operated by Driver 2. Driver 1 reported the crash to responding
officers and stated having pain in the left knee after the impact. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of
Driver 1's vehicle and was confirmed by both drivers and by a responding witness as being inside the vehicle at the
time of the collision. Several bystanders and Driver 2 gave statements consistent with Driver 1's account of how the
lane change and contact occurred. Photographs taken at the scene show damage along the left rear quarter panel of
Driver 1's vehicle and the right front side of Driver 2's vehicle, which is largely consistent with a sideswipe of this
nature. Some older scratches were also noted on the same panel, and it is unclear whether these predate the
collision. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy under review. The reported knee injury appears consistent
with the type and force of impact described at the scene.
